verdict.rationale: PostHog documents batch exports that schedule data exports to supported destinations, and notes that bulk or recurring exports should use batch exports or file download exports. It also offers realtime destinations, including a generic JSON webhook, and an MIT-licensed self-host option, which together give a plausible exit path. The evidence is thin on the details: it does not name open file formats and does not show that every data type, such as session replays, can be exported. Missing for 10: explicit open export formats (e.g. Parquet/CSV/JSON files), evidence that all data types including replays and persons can be fully exported, documented migration/offboarding guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.
